purpose: Coverage contract for bringing the Adobe sheet's stored choices and mechanics into the web character system without depending on Acrobat APIs.
notes: The web catalogue may contain more entries than the Adobe base lists; parity means the Adobe entries must not be missing.

Long copyrighted book prose and Acrobat-specific executable code are not a parity requirement. Mechanical facts, choices, progression relationships, source references and usable character-sheet behavior are.
The Adobe PDF contains 24 document-level JavaScript modules; parity is tracked by feature/data coverage rather than copying those modules verbatim.
